description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the GLClosures API resource in the Fineract accounting module. It includes response and request classes with schema annotations for API documentation purposes.

classes.name: GLClosuresApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A final class serving as a container for Swagger documentation inner classes representing the GLClosures API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetGlClosureResponse
classes.description: Schema-defined class representing the response for a GLClosure entity, including fields like id, office details, dates, user info, and comments.

classes.name: PostGlClosuresRequest
classes.description: Schema-defined class representing the request payload for creating a new GLClosure, including office ID, closing date, comments, locale, and date format.

classes.name: PostGlClosuresResponse
classes.description: Schema-defined class for the response after creating a GLClosure, providing office ID and resource ID.

classes.name: PutGlClosuresRequest
classes.description: Schema-defined class representing the request to update a GLClosure, primarily comments.

classes.name: PutGlClosuresResponse
classes.description: Schema-defined class representing the response after updating a GLClosure, including office ID, resource ID, and comments.

classes.name: DeleteGlClosuresResponse
classes.description: Schema-defined class representing the response after deleting a GLClosure, including office ID and resource ID.
